svg.text: One tap on the Lamp button: show it first, then wait for the answer
Concepts 1–2 · POST /devices/:id/command waits for the ack for at most 5 seconds · example f00d00000001, the lamp is Off
while waiting, the button can't be tapped again (aria-disabled): no 409 from a double click
Five possible answers and what you see afterwards
the device carried out the command; the state is
200 isn't always success: the device refused.
E.g. the pump: pump refused: tank water too low.
The server forgets that wish: not sent again.
Lamp: device is offline, command not sent
not sent: the device has just gone offline, its
key was revoked, it is Node 2, or another
command is still waiting (another tab or phone).
Usually the button is disabled first. 403, 404,
503: the same, the toast shows the server's text.
Lamp: not confirmed by the device yet; the
server will try again when it hears from
lamp f00d00000001 reported false, but true is
NOT cancelled. The device didn't answer within
5 seconds, but the server remembers the "On" wish.
As soon as it hears that device again (≥ 30 seconds
after the last try), the server sends it again itself:
the lamp turns on without anyone tapping.
lab: silent mock made obedient again → +35.2 seconds
backend stopped or Wi-Fi down. Tried in the lab with
Another tab or phone learns it from telemetry
there is no Socket.IO ack event: from the server to the dashboard
the device sends a new reading at once when its state changes;
state.lamp in it updates the button on other screens at the latest
±2 seconds later (lab: the other browser changed < ½ second after the click)
The pump is deliberately NOT optimistic
"water for 5 seconds" repeated = watering twice; water that has
come out can't be pulled back
its title stays Idle + "Waiting for device confirmation…", and
turns Watering only after ack.ok: true; disabled while watering
without an ack (504): the server doesn't send a pump command again
